_comment: Field table for this site's NCE sessions, written from the 2026-09-02 discovery run, never guessed. This site's data path is the NCEToHost HL7 copies NCE drops into SavedCopies alongside the device XML: hl7_signals maps their OBX-3 numeric MDC codes to our slugs. 150022 (MDC_PRESS_BLD_NONINV_DIA, diastolic) is deliberately unmapped — the engine has no diastolic signal — so it will show in the discovery report; that is expected, not a fault. The XML sections below stay empty: the device XML is WACP object serialisation (MEMBER name= / child VALUE), kept for discovery only.
